svg.title: Diagram: two layers, one holder each
svg.desc: A hand-drawn notebook diagram in two lanes. Left, The Runtime: Site plus Plugin points down to PHP Binary, holder host, image, vendor, which fans out to a WAF Rule stopgap and a Binary Update fix. Right, The Connection: AI Tool points down to Shared Identity and then Connected System, check permission here. A shared note card reads The Check: minimum capability, minimum permission, check authorization where the action happens.

text.tspan: the fix lives one layer below
grant the least the job needs
check authorization where the action happens
Carried claims re-derived from run records and primaries opened 12 Nov 2026.
Solid paths are verified; the stopgap buys time but never closes the flaw.
